offline_replay: Replaying the saved candidates with the unchanged normalizer reproduced all seven accepted outputs and all three failures. No API calls or output repairs were used for replay.
whole_report_rule: Successful processing; no missing/extra observations or candidates; all candidate checks and normalized core fields correct; issue flags match; all quotes exact and complete. Exact time_text differences reported separately and reviewed for semantic validity.
interpretation: The run removes count/rating fragmentation, but quote stitching and a nausea scope error reduce accepted whole reports from 8/10 to 7/10. Reject this candidate as an overall improvement on this run.
limitations: All ten cases are now development/regression cases used to guide this prompt; this is not fresh validation.
Ten controlled synthetic texts, AI-assisted labels and review, and the same generation/extraction model family.
One saved baseline attempt and one new attempt per report; stochastic variability is not estimated.
No distinct-date, event/window, current-versus-worst, conflicting-value, or medication-context negative controls in this set; guardrails are reviewed instructions, not broadly tested safety.
A clean result here cannot establish generalization or justify automatic default-prompt/dashboard replacement.
